Tower Reborn

🛠️  Commands:
/stageselector - Stage selector
/sectiontype [type] - Switch section types
/filtersections [filters] - Filter sections
/insertsection [name] [slot] - Insert sections
/lock & /unlock - Control shop
/sban [UserID] - Ban users
/rank [player] [rank] - Assign ranks
/newlobby 
/2018lobby
/naturelobby 

Utility Commands:

/headless - Toggle headless
/korblox - Toggle Korblox

K - Toggle GUI, Shift + P turns on Freecam
